reason: The README clearly describes an interactive PBR 3D model previewer for GLB/GLTF assets with material inspection and browser controls, so visualization is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于在浏览器中交互预览 GLB/GLTF 三维模型，并检查 PBR 材质通道、纹理与环境光照效果。
summaries.en: An interactive browser-based previewer for GLB/GLTF 3D models with PBR material-channel inspection, textures, and environment lighting.

capabilities: Renders GLB and GLTF 3D models in an interactive browser preview
Reads supported model and texture files from the workspace
Provides a pbr_render tool and pbr3d display format
Supports material-channel inspection, environment lighting, orbit controls, exposure, auto-rotation, and fullscreen viewing
